abort.already_configured: School menu is already configured. Only one entry is supported.
abort.already_in_progress: Another School menu configuration flow is already in progress.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one School menu entry is supported.

path_not_allowed.message: {path} is outside the allowed folders. Put the PDF under /config/www or a media folder.

entry_not_loaded.message: The School menu integration is not loaded.

exactly_one_source.message: Provide exactly one of file_path or file_id.

upload_not_found.message: That upload is no longer available. Upload the PDF again.

no_mailbox.message: No mailbox is configured. Set one up under School Menu → Configure first.

check_mail_skipped.message: The mailbox was checked just now or is being checked. Try again in a minute.

import_pdf.name: Import menu PDF
import_pdf.description: Reads a weekly school-menu PDF and stores the week it contains. Either from disk (under /config/www or a media folder) or from an upload.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Absolute path to the PDF, under /config/www or a media folder.

file_id.name: Uploaded file
file_id.description: A PDF uploaded through the UI. Use this or File path, not both.

week_start.name: Week start
week_start.description: Monday of the week the PDF covers. Only used when the PDF header has no readable date range.

check_mail.name: Check mail now
check_mail.description: Checks the configured mailbox right away and re-reads every school mail of the last 14 days, including attachments that were refused before. Menus already stored are not imported twice.

data_description.senders: Who may send the menu. A full address, or @domain for everyone at that domain (default: @annie-heuser.schule).
data_description.subject_filter: A mail counts only if its subject contains this text (any case) and it has a PDF attachment.
data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often the mailbox is checked, 5–1440 minutes. Use the 'Check mail now' button for an immediate check.

error.no_senders: Add at least one sender address or @domain.
error.no_host: Enter the IMAP server host name.
error.invalid_sender: Every sender must be a single e-mail address or @domain, e.g. @annie-heuser.schule.
error.no_subject_filter: Enter a subject filter; an empty filter would match every mail.
